description: Fonte unica dos tokens e presets de tema da VERSI Design System.

tokens.selector:
html[data-contrast="high"] :where(a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]):not(:where(.sr-only, .field-inset-focus-ring, :disabled, [aria-disabled="true"], .field-keyboard-focus-ring .field-value, .radio-option-focus input)):focus-visible,
html[data-contrast="high"] :where(.field-keyboard-focus-ring):has(.field-value:focus-visible),
html[data-contrast="high"] :where(.radio-option-focus):has(input:focus-visible),
html[data-contrast="high"] :where(.peer):focus-visible + :where(.checkbox-control-proxy, .radio-control-proxy)
